product_metadata.title: Homde Heated Blanket Electric Throw Blanket 50 Inch x 60 Inch Flannel Toast Bread Electric Blanket with 3 Temperature Settings & 4 Hours Auto-Off, Fast Heating, Overheating Protection Machine Washable
features: [Design Concept] One day, when our designer was eating toast, he had a sudden inspiration: if this was a throw, what a fun thing! Then, he chose the color of the toast and some of the textures to redesign, resulting in this interesting heated throw. Enjoy wonderful winter with this cute heated throw!

[Safe and Reliable] This electric throw blanket is certificated by ETL. Shuts off automatically after 4 hours of continuous use, no worry of forgotten shutoff. Overheat protection promotes safer use experience

[Soft and Durable] Both sides of the heated blanket throw are made of flannel, which is comfortable and soft to touch. After removing the controller, the blanket can be hand-washed or machine-washed, durable and not easy to fade

[Easy to Use] With LCD controller, the electric throw has 3 optional temperatures (range: 90-107°F), and you can choose the appropriate temperature according to your needs. In addition, the heating throw is equipped with about 10 feet of wire, so you can easily use the electric heating pad on the bed, sofa or chair

[Multipurpose] This interesting exterior design brings a unique decoration to your home. The 50 x 60 inch electric blanket is suitable for you to sit on the sofa, chair or bed while watching TV or playing games. Perfect gifts for Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, Father's Day, Halloween, Thanksgiving, and Christmas
